name: august-theme
description: August — Personal / portfolio Astro theme rendered as an interactive design canvas. Faint grid + ruler, sticker notes, a live clock, and a stacking folder-card case-study deck. Built with Astro 7 + Tailwind v4.

scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=august-theme
